We take concerns about staff attitude, communication, and clinical decision-making extremely seriously. Diagnosis and prescribing are not always as straightforward as they may appear, and clinicians are required to use a range of evidence-based resources, including NICE guidelines and other clinical tools, many of which are now accessed online, to support safe and appropriate decision-making. The use of such resources is a normal and expected part of good clinical practice, rather than guesswork.

That said, we fully recognise that this may not have been communicated clearly at the time, and for that we apologise. We would very much welcome the opportunity to look into this matter properly. If you are willing, we kindly ask that you contact the practice directly and provide your details so we can investigate further. This can be done by submitting an Anima request (https://anima.thirdparty.nhs.uk/blue/o/pe73jlyax), by calling 01733 240 478 (option 3), or via our online complaints form (https://www.yaxleygp.nhs.uk/form-complaints-form).
